final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Attività scolastiche'
  AND surface_area >= 180
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C')
  AND mobility >= 50.54
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: The user prefers proximity to public transport. Expressed as a convenience preference, so the threshold is the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.

The user requires energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C. Gross floor area (180 sqm), capacity (14 people), Turin location and public transport proximity are outside the energy-efficiency scope and are not included.
